$comment: RFU document acquisition log, recorded under the standing acquisition rule.
THE AUTHORITY IS ALWAYS THE RFU. canonical_source_url is the provenance a
published fact cites, regardless of where the bytes were actually obtained.
A mirror is only ever an ACQUISITION COPY -- a way to get the file -- and
englandrugby.com returns HTTP 403 to every automated request, including
robots.txt, at the CloudFront layer. That control was NOT circumvented: no
proxy rotation, no client spoofing, no challenge bypass, no session reuse.
The block is recorded as a fact about acquisition, not worked around.
OUTCOME: no candidate mirror establishes equivalence with the CURRENT
season's official document. Every candidate is therefore
NEEDS_HUMAN_SOURCE_VERIFICATION and no fact may be extracted from any of
them. A one-time human download is requested (see ingestion_request).

UPDATE 2026-09-07: the developer supplied the official Regulation 15 appendix text directly, after automated retrieval was refused. Phase 4B extraction for Union age grades is unblocked. See ingestion_request.fulfilment.

access_control.layer: CloudFront / WAF - blanket block, robots.txt also 403
access_control.note: Retested this phase with a plain unauthenticated GET. No attempt was made to defeat the control.

candidates.target_document: RFU Regulation 15 Appendix 3 - U9s Rules of Play (Transitional Contact)
candidates.acquisition_method: public HTTPS GET, no authentication, no evasion

verification.body_text: MATCH - opening paragraph matches the wording on the official RFU page verbatim
verification.season_or_version: ABSENT - no season, version or effective date stated anywhere in the document
verification.publication_metadata: FAILS - Author 'Richard Nunn', Creator 'Microsoft Word', created 2023-07-31. This is an individual's word-processed document, not an RFU-produced artefact.

candidates.reasoning: The TEXT appears to be the RFU's, but the FILE is not. A Word document authored by a named individual is a re-creation, not an exact copy: it could have been retyped, reflowed, abridged or edited, and nothing in it says which season it represents. The 2024 upload date is misleading -- the file itself was made in 2023. This is precisely the failure mode the acquisition rule exists to catch, and the recency of the upload is exactly what would have made it tempting.

candidates.target_document: RFU Regulation 15 - Age Grade Rugby (master regulation)
candidates.acquisition_method: public HTTPS GET, no authentication, no evasion

verification.age_grade: N/A - covers the whole Age Grade framework
verification.body_text: PLAUSIBLE - contains genuine numbered regulation clauses (15.1.1 onward) and links to englandrugby.com resources
verification.season_or_version: ABSENT - no season, version or effective date located in the extracted text
verification.publication_metadata: ABSENT - no document-info dictionary; producer and creation date unavailable

candidates.reasoning: The content reads as genuine RFU regulation text, but with no stated version and no publication metadata there is no way to establish WHICH edition it is. Regulation 15 changes between seasons; an undated copy uploaded in 2023 cannot be asserted to be the current one. Rugby Hub is season-effective by design, so a fact with an unknown effective period is not a fact it can hold.

candidates.target_document: RFU Regulation 15 - Age Grade Rugby, 2017/18 edition
candidates.acquisition_method: public HTTPS GET, no authentication, no evasion

verification.season_or_version: STATED - 2017/18, in the filename and consistent with the 2017-07-07 creation date
verification.publication_metadata: STRONG - Adobe InDesign CS6 / Adobe PDF Library, created 2017-07-07. Consistent with a professionally produced governing-body artefact.

candidates.reasoning: Ironically the most credible artefact of the three -- it looks like a genuine RFU-produced PDF -- and the least usable, because it is nine seasons out of date. Useful only if Ovalball ever wants historical regulatory context for a past season, and then only as an explicitly historical record. It must never supply a current fact. Note the contrast with the candidate above: professional typesetting metadata is what an authentic governing-body document looks like.

corroboration_findings.$comment: Constituent bodies were consulted to corroborate the appendix STRUCTURE. They are reputable RFU bodies but are still secondary listings, so they are evidence about what to look for -- never authority for a rule.

conflict_detected.topic: Regulation 15 appendix gender scope, and the existence of girls-specific appendices

source_a.claim: Appendices 6, 7, 8 and 9 are labelled BOYS ONLY, and a further Appendix 10 exists for U13 GIRLS plus a girls U15-U18 variations document.

source_b.organisation: Nottinghamshire, Lincolnshire & Derbyshire RFU (RFU constituent body)
source_b.claim: Appendices 6, 8 and 9 are mixed; only Appendix 7 (U13) is boys-only; no Appendix 10 is listed at all.

conflict_detected.why_it_matters: Phase 4A recorded Union girls age grades as RESEARCH_REQUIRED on the grounds that we had not established whether girls' Rules of Play differ. One constituent body says they demonstrably do and names the appendix; the other does not list it. Both are reputable, neither is authority, and neither states a season -- so the difference may be a genuine regulatory change that one body has not reflected, or simply a stale page.
conflict_detected.resolution: UNRESOLVED. Not resolved by preferring the newer-looking or more detailed page. Resolving it requires the RFU's own current Regulation 15 index, which is behind the 403. Girls age grades therefore REMAIN RESEARCH_REQUIRED, and no girls identity is created on the strength of a county page.
conflict_detected.effect_on_publication: Blocking for all Union girls identities.

ingestion_request.reason: No candidate establishes equivalence with the current season's official document. Two lack any version at all; the one with a verifiable version is the 2017/18 edition.

The regulatory_sources row RFU-REG15-APP1-2025-001, recorded in an INDEPENDENT earlier pass, already carried effective_from = 2025-08-01. The supplied text agrees with what the database recorded before it arrived, which is real corroboration rather than assertion.

fulfilment.provenance_caveat: Text pasted into a session cannot carry a SHA-256 or publication metadata, so it is not byte-verifiable the way a downloaded PDF would be. It is accepted because it is developer-supplied from the official source, it is internally consistent, and its stated effective date independently matches a previously recorded value. If byte-level provenance is later required, the PDFs should still be placed in research-ingestion/rfu/.
